blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Energy (DOE) has terminated its planned coal mine auction set for this year, including the highly coveted Semirara Island, as it seeks to overhaul awarding rules and ensure greater economic gains for the government. In an advisory dated September 15, the agency scrapped the 2026 coal bid round covering three predetermined areas under the Philippine Conventional Energy Contracting Program.
